note: One data-driven definition of every check this repository runs, and of the lane each one runs in. `composer qa` is still the human entry point, but the set it executes is derived from this file rather than restated beside it: tools/quality-contract.php --check fails when a check declared for the local lane is missing from the qa script, when the qa script runs a check this file does not declare, when a check names a workflow or job that does not exist, or when the workflow that declares a check no longer contains the command. Nightly and release execute manifest-owned checks through tools/quality-contract.php --run and delegate a check that has an explicit binding for that lane to the named, provisioned workflow job. A check that cannot run in a lane says so here, with the reason, rather than being quietly dropped or duplicated.

local.note: The human entry point. Its member set is this file's local lane, proven equal in both directions by tools/quality-contract.php --check.

ci.note: The merge lane keeps its steps written out so a reader of the workflow can see what runs, and every one of them is bound to this file: a check declaring the ci cadence must name the workflow and job that carries it, and the check fails when that job no longer contains the command.

nightly.note: Nightly executes manifest-owned checks here and delegates explicitly bound checks to their named workflow jobs, so browser requirements stay with the job that provisions them.

release.note: The release lane executes manifest-owned checks here and reports explicitly bound checks as delegated. Before this file existed the release job carried its own shorter list, which is exactly the drift this contract removes.

engines.name: MariaDB LTS
engines.note: The canonical engine. The full suite, the coverage measurement and the browser journeys all run here, and the coverage ratchet reads this leg.

engines.name: MySQL 8.4 LTS
engines.note: Primary alongside MariaDB. Receives the same suite and the same browser journeys at merge.

engines.name: PostgreSQL 17
engines.note: Not optional and not reduced: the full suite and the browser journeys run here at merge, and a failure blocks the release.

regression_matrix.note: The criterion is assessable because this block names what has to be true and tools/quality-contract.php --check proves the workflow does it: the database job's matrix carries all three declared engines, and every leg runs the complete suite — the legs without coverage through `composer test`, the canonical leg through the coverage invocation of the same suite. Assessing the criterion is then reading the run, not inspecting the workflow.

checks.title: Composer metadata and lockfile are immutable and resolvable
checks.purpose: Prove the committed dependency graph installs exactly as locked and that no step rewrote composer.json or composer.lock.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: The dry run resolves against the network; qa is documented as running inside the application container.

checks.title: Locked dependencies carry no advisory and no abandoned package
checks.purpose: Fail the build on a known vulnerability or an abandoned package in the locked graph.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: The audit resolves advisories over the network, which the application container does not reach.

checks.title: No secret-shaped literal enters the history
checks.purpose: Scan the branch history, not the working tree, so a literal introduced by an earlier commit is caught before the push.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: It needs a Docker daemon, and qa is documented as running inside the application container where there is none.

checks.title: Authenticated Studio preview negative-path qualification evidence
checks.purpose: Retain the authority, transport, replay, single-use-grant, observability and route-only CSP refusal suite as an explicit P7-C application-security artifact; scanners supplement these proofs and never replace them.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: The same tests already run in the ordinary local PHPUnit suite; this named invocation exists to retain a separately reviewable P7-C security artifact in the Security workflow.

checks.title: Architecture policy: textual predicates and the semantic dependency graph
checks.purpose: Refuse the product-name transcription error, forbidden direct dependencies, forbidden framework imports and static service location, and then evaluate every dependency edge in src/ against the declared layer graph.

checks.title: Canonical first-party package identities without runtime aliases
checks.purpose: Reject class aliases in tracked App runtime, resources, tests and examples and in installed Conversion, Extension SDK and Producer source/resources so an extracted type has exactly one canonical package identity.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: It runs inside composer architecture:policy, which qa executes; the separate script exists so it can be run and read on its own.

checks.title: Semantic dependency direction with an expiring violation baseline
checks.purpose: Resolve every symbol reference in src/ to its layer and fail any edge the layer graph forbids; existing violations are held in a baseline with an owner and an expiry, and a new one fails immediately.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: It runs inside composer architecture:policy, which qa executes; the separate script exists so it can be run and read on its own.

checks.title: The quality contract matches what is executed
checks.purpose: Fail when this manifest and the qa script disagree in either direction, when a declared workflow or job is missing, or when a workflow no longer carries the command it is declared to run.

checks.title: Documentation-block completeness
checks.purpose: Refuse a documentable member without a block, a summary, a @since, a @param, or a @return.

checks.title: Documentation blocks are in their canonical form
checks.purpose: Run the formatter in check mode and fail when it would still change a block. CI already formats src/ and refuses any resulting diff, but nothing local did, so a hand-aligned block passed composer qa and failed the merge lane on alignment alone. Declaring it here makes the local lane answer the same question as CI rather than a weaker one.

checks.title: The reproducible baseline is current
checks.purpose: Hold docs/quality/baseline.json to the tree it describes (P0-A). Every figure is derived, so a route, command, migration, OpenAPI operation, recorded exemption or skip that appears or disappears without the record moving fails the build. A baseline nobody regenerates is a baseline nobody can trust; the hand-written one drifted nine hundred commits.

checks.title: Documentation-block record for tests/
checks.purpose: Hold tests/ to the documentation standard src/ is held to, against a shrinking record of the debt that existed when the gate was armed (V2-QA-010). Every rule the tool checks is covered except line width, which phpcs.xml already enforces in tests/ at the same 120 characters. Entries are keyed by file, code and class-qualified member, so the recorded count is a burn-down rather than a number that can be edited down.

checks.title: Documentation-block alignment is committed, not pending
checks.purpose: Apply the house alignment rules and fail when the result differs from what is committed.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: It rewrites files; qa must not mutate the working tree, so the clean-tree assertion lives in the workflow that can make it.

checks.title: Interface programme coherence
checks.purpose: Prove every declared surface, journey and work item still resolves to something the application registers.

checks.title: The roadmap ledger and changelog retain truthful lifecycle evidence
checks.purpose: Fail when a finished finding is left behind in the ledger instead of moving to the changelog, or when a changelog citation no longer resolves after history is rewritten.

checks.title: The public extension contract is frozen and every promised generation still installs
checks.purpose: Fail when the classified public surface changes without a deliberate generation bump, or when a promised manifest or SPI generation stops satisfying its signed compatibility fixture.

checks.title: Author packages and examples never import the private App host
checks.purpose: Reject Kumwe\App\ namespaces in the SDK classification and generation ledgers, retained generation source, generated scaffold source, and installable examples; historical fixtures are regenerated and re-signed against canonical libraries instead of preserved through aliases or remapping.

checks.title: Installed Conversion provider profile matches App consumer evidence
checks.purpose: Recompute extension-provider-v1 from the installed package-owned full type-shape manifest, prove its canonical ordered closure autoloads without aliases, and compare only its digest and count with App consumer evidence.

checks.title: The retained CLI generation matches the live command graph
checks.purpose: Fail when the live command names differ from the immutable CLI generation, when its executable input grammar, file-backed secret transport, or declared portable exits are violated, or when the deployed and documentation copies differ byte for byte. Output modes, exit meanings, and closed action-level risk remain compatibility-pinned metadata rather than claims that the dispatcher introspects command output.

checks.title: The retained MCP generation matches the live capability catalogue
checks.purpose: Fail when a live tool, resource, prompt, schema, mutation requirement, risk classification, or stable error contract differs from the immutable MCP generation.

checks.title: The vendored Studio contract corpus matches its pinned release
checks.purpose: Recompute every SRI digest the published Studio protocol and testkit manifests declare against the vendored bytes, hold each corpus directory closed in both directions, and fail when the vendored package versions drift from the PIN record (kumwe/app#104, D16).

checks.title: Extracted libraries and Studio are pinned to exact reproducible coordinates
checks.purpose: Bind kumwe/conversion, kumwe/extension-sdk, and kumwe/producer to exact versions and official immutable Composer lock references; bind every @kumwe/studio* manifest entry to its exact package-lock version, official registry URL and integrity; and fail unless Producer's release, protocol, corpus digest, package family, claimed profiles, and release-record bytes equal App's coordinated Studio evidence (ADR 0007, V2-STU-002).

checks.title: The capability index matches the installed Kumwe packages
checks.purpose: Regenerate the capability index from composer.lock, the installed vendor/kumwe manifests, the legacy registry and the migration ledger, and fail when docs/architecture/capability-index.md or its embedded digest differs, when a locked Kumwe package is installed without Version 2 manifests and is not an approved legacy entry, when two packages claim one FQCN, capability or service, or when a provider or handoff is undocumented (NRM-2026-001, Kumwe-v2-02).

checks.title: App production growth is recorded and duplicates no installed Kumwe package
checks.purpose: Scan every class-like under src/, classify it through docs/architecture/layers.json, digest its public surface and compare the inventory with docs/architecture/governance/core-growth-baseline.json, the capability index, the migration ledger and the Core Growth Records; fail on a stale capability index or baseline, a duplicate FQCN or service owner, a reintroduced extracted namespace or removed App symbol, a likely duplicate responsibility of a package symbol, new or widened shared/domain/application growth without an approved KUMWE-CGR record, unrecorded host-layer growth, a reference to a retired namespace, or a broken Core Growth Record (NRM-2026-001, Kumwe-v2-02).

checks.title: The generated OpenAPI document matches the routes that exist
checks.purpose: Regenerate the contract and fail when it differs from the committed artifact.

checks.title: Compiled message catalogues match their XLIFF source
checks.purpose: Fail when the committed compiled catalogue is not what the source compiles to.

checks.title: No enforced surface carries user-facing text inline
checks.purpose: Fail the build when a new hardcoded user-facing string is introduced.

checks.title: No stylesheet pins a rule to one writing direction
checks.purpose: Keep the right-to-left conversion from regressing one physical declaration at a time.

checks.title: Behavioural tests attribute the classes they exercise
checks.purpose: Hold #[CoversNothing] to the reasoned allowlist in docs/quality/coverage-contract.json so a behavioural test cannot execute real code and contribute nothing to attribution.

checks.title: Coverage does not fall, measured on the canonical engine
checks.purpose: Read the clover report from the canonical MariaDB leg and fail a global decrease beyond the declared tolerance.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: It reads a clover report produced by a coverage-instrumented full-suite run against a live database, which a local qa invocation does not produce.

checks.title: The integration suite repeated and reverse-ordered against one reused database
checks.purpose: After the complete suite's first integration run, execute the integration suite again in declaration order and then with its classes listed in reverse while preserving method order. Judge both passes against the shrinking pass-aware record in docs/quality/idempotency-baseline.json. The record is empty, and the process-scoped fixture lifecycle withdraws each run's newly published run-unique definitions together with their live schema installations before the next pass while retaining a bounded set of shared replay fixtures, so all three consecutive runs exercise one database without transient contracts consuming the live OpenAPI definition bound.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: It needs a live database that has already carried one full integration run, which a local qa invocation does not produce.

checks.title: The deployed artifact runs its own regression cases
checks.purpose: Exercise the production autoloader, the --no-dev dependency set, a read-only tree and the real console binary early enough to fail before a deployment is stood up, and reproduce the four defects the last programme found only in deployment acceptance.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: It builds a separate --no-dev installation of the archived artifact, which takes minutes and needs the network; qa stays the fast local gate.

checks.title: PSR-12 layout and the 120-column limit
checks.purpose: Keep the tree in one shape so a diff shows meaning rather than formatting.

checks.title: PHPStan at level max
checks.purpose: Refuse a type error, a widened array shape or an impossible condition before it reaches a test.

checks.title: The complete PHPUnit suite on every declared engine
checks.purpose: Run unit, integration, functional and architecture suites against MariaDB, MySQL and PostgreSQL, which is the evidence Gate A exit criterion 12 is assessed on.

checks.title: Frontend type-checks and every generated frontend asset reproduces committed bytes
checks.purpose: Fail when the locked source graph does not reproduce the Vite build tree and generated site runtime fallback.
checks.command: bash -euo pipefail -c 'npm run check; npm run build; generated_status="$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all -- public/assets/build public/assets/site.css)"; test -z "$generated_status"'
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: It is the frontend contract and runs under Node, not under the PHP entry point. It is a merge and nightly gate rather than a release one because both generated artifacts — public/assets/build and public/assets/site.css — are committed, verified byte for byte at merge, and travel into the release archive unchanged.

checks.title: Browser, accessibility and visual journeys on every declared engine
checks.purpose: Run the critical administrator, portal, generated-business, owned-line, maker-checker, step-up, policy-denial, no-JavaScript and website journeys against all three engines at merge, and report first-attempt results separately from retried ones. The two further browser engines are the nightly breadth check, declared separately.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: It needs a browser runtime, a live database and a running web server.

checks.title: Desktop and mobile Firefox and WebKit journeys, nightly
checks.purpose: Carry the complete desktop behavioural and accessibility journeys onto the two engines merge does not have time for, plus bounded mobile touch, keyboard, focus, forced-colour, zoom and reflow proofs on both. The forced-colour proof verifies both media-query activation and a product-owned computed-style change rather than treating matchMedia alone as product evidence. Pixel baselines stay with Chromium and all four breadth projects declare that they ignore snapshots rather than comparing against a baseline that was never theirs; the cross-engine screenshot attachment is explicitly named evidence-only. The evidence records commit, database, project, browser, viewport, locale and fixture. The workflow enforces at least 99 percent first-attempt success overall, while tests/Browser/nightly-critical-journeys.json is the closed exact-title/project set for which a missing journey, final failure or retry-only pass is rejected.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: Two further browser engines do not fit the merge budget, which is why they are nightly.

checks.title: The performance harness reproduces a stable breakpoint report, nightly
checks.purpose: Run the harness's breakpoint mode against the nightly database: ramp the document line axis twice, price each size by interpolating the two declared commit objectives, and record where measured p95 first crosses that line. A changed knee always fails. Away from the knee, a p95 pair fails when its delta breaches both the 35% relative tolerance and 10% of its interpolated objective, so immaterial shared-runner jitter cannot masquerade as a breakpoint while a material divergence still fails. The phase-2 exit gate asks for a report that is stable, not merely produced, and the written document names its own role as a baseline fact about that host and commit, never a capacity claim.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: The ramp commits dozens of large documents against a live database, which does not fit the merge budget; nightly is its declared cadence.

checks.title: Complete deployment acceptance against the built images
checks.purpose: Stand the deployment up on every supported engine and both distribution formats and probe it.
checks.excluded_from_qa_reason: It builds and runs containers; qa runs inside one.
